question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}^{′}(t)=-7x(t)+y(t) \\ {y}^{′}(t)=-7y(t)\end{aligned}
$$

Find the general solution to the system of ODEs above.

*Hint: ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14150255/assets/4c7ca8aa3fb83e7c4ce806080257e8f3b3d5186e19f10649a0bed7202f6501b6.svg) where ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14150255/assets/0492dd33f8d39d4a74139be25415d6d943888d8ccbf67158690f0960c5334415.svg)*
question.worked_solution:
Writing our system in matrix form, we get
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14150255/assets/85304407fca2ace2d7fb5d97123e1f27f45386c8f3ebcc1a1c3859d1b573d2b0.svg)
where ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14150255/assets/81bcc770826e2156f310569f014356cc686541259c11aa190ac28394a6d38725.svg) So, the matrix of the system is ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14150255/assets/310669815cad029379ffa4022fa9094ef8597d91496c57f70c66ed51926836b3.svg)

Given the system $\mathbf{x}'(t) = A \mathbf{x}(t),$ where $A$ is a constant square matrix, the general solution of the system can be written as

$$
\mathbf{x}(t) = \Phi(t) \, \mathbf{c},
$$

where $\Phi(t)$ is a fundamental matrix of the system, and $\mathbf{c}$ is a constant vector.

Now, using the given information, the standard fundamental matrix $\Phi_0(t)$ of the system is given by
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14150255/assets/e128d7d4610a3a9021b1391f278822bcdf113570500b822c05370e473923f5b7.svg)

Therefore, the general solution is

$$
\begin{aligned}x(t) & ={Φ}_{0}(t)\,c \\  & ={e}^{At}\,c \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{e}^{-7t} & t{e}^{-7t} \\ 0 & {e}^{-7t}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{c}_{1} \\ {c}_{2}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}{e}^{-7t} \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}t{e}^{-7t} \\ {e}^{-7t}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{-7t}+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}t \\ 1\end{aligned}]{e}^{-7t},\end{aligned}
$$

where $c_1,c_2 \in \mathbb{R}.$
